pages.title: Effects
pages.text: $(l)Hemorrhage$(): 3s bleed. $(l)Piercing$(): ignores some armor. $(l)Puller$(): drags the target toward you. $(l)Resonance$(): 30% follow-up hit after a delay. $(l)Distance$(): +1% damage per block flown. $(l)Grappling$(): yanks you to where it lands. $(l)Rope$(): places a climbable line. $(l)Potion Payload$(): dip to tip with any potion.
